name: Kyouhaku Yuutousei Shimai ~Furyou Group Shuudan Tanetsuke Ochi~
original_name: 脅迫優等生姉妹 ～不良グループ集団種付堕ち～
source:
Aoi Masaki, the upright student council president --
Her little sister, Kaede Masaki --
Both have caught the eye of a gang of delinquents.
Aoi is lured into their trap, and her violation is recorded on film.
Using the video as blackmail, the group forces Aoi to tend to their every desire.
Worried about her sister, Kaede follows her one day, and is shocked to find her being
violated by the gang. Unfortunately for her, the delinquents hear her gasp of surprise,
and now the two girls will never be the same...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE268893.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
正直的学生会长真崎葵，以及她的妹妹真崎枫，被一群不良少年盯上了。
葵被诱入圈套，遭到性侵，过程还被拍了下来。
对方以视频要挟，逼迫葵服从他们的一切要求。
担心姐姐的枫有一天跟踪了她，却震惊地发现姐姐正遭受那群人的侵害。
不幸的是，她惊讶的叫声引起了对方的注意。此后，姐妹俩的生活再也无法回到从前……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE268893.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
